crossRefs.note: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

translations.web: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
translations.bsb: “What did He do to you?” they asked. “How did He open your eyes?”
translations.kjv: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
translations.asv: They said therefore unto him, What did he to thee? How opened he thine eyes?
